summary: Sprint 1 (permanent PDF ingestion async fix) — backend-only verification. Ran full studio pytest suite (test_studio_async_ingestion.py + test_studio_pipeline.py + test_studio_bulk_edit.py + test_studio_sprint87.py): 41 passed, 3 skipped (already-consumed drafts, expected). Additional live curl verification against the public preview URL covers every Sprint 1 acceptance criterion: (a) small text+image PDF upload returned HTTP 200 in 141ms with status=processing/records=0, transitioned to status=review, records_extracted=1, extraction_mode=text within ~1s; (b) event-loop responsiveness during processing — GET /api/admin/studio/uploads 108ms and POST /api/auth/login 332ms (both well under 3s); (c) invalid PDF (garbage bytes) → HTTP 400 'Not a valid PDF: Failed to open stream' with NO ke_uploads row inserted (verified by count diff = 0 junk rows); (d) non-PDF filename bad.txt → HTTP 400 'Only PDF files are accepted'; (e) reprocess endpoint returns in 105ms with status=processing and message, background task runs and leaves upload in terminal state; (f) replace endpoint returns in 185ms with status=processing, extraction runs in background; (g) failure_reason field is populated on failures and null on success (verified by test_upload_never_stuck_in_processing). Skipped the 25MB image-only PDF live test — the /tmp/catalogue.pdf fixture is not present in this fresh container, but the same async path is exercised by all upload tests and the main agent already curl-verified the 25MB → 53 records / 3min OCR path. All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: _run_studio_extraction correctly wraps the blocking extractor in asyncio.to_thread; the try/except ensures a terminal status ('review' or 'failed') is always written — good.
studio_upload validates PDF magic bytes via fitz.open() BEFORE inserting the ke_uploads row, so invalid PDFs leave no orphan row (verified live).
server.py is now ~6408 lines — Studio routes still need to be extracted into backend/routes/studio.py post-freeze (carried over from iteration_14).
reprocess + replace share almost identical wipe+spawn logic — a small helper could remove ~40 lines of duplication.
seed_data_creation: Tests create + delete throwaway async_*.pdf / live_small.pdf / lifecycle_*.pdf uploads; TestCleanup fixtures remove them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full studio regression: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<preview> PYTHONPATH=/app/backend pytest tests/test_studio_async_ingestion.py tests/test_studio_pipeline.py tests/test_studio_bulk_edit.py tests/test_studio_sprint87.py -v (44 tests, ~8s). The 25MB image-only path is not covered live in the sandbox (fixture absent) but is exercised by test_upload_returns_immediately + test_login_responsive_during_extraction on the async code path.
rca of the issue: N/A — Sprint 1 async ingestion works end-to-end.
